intro: Section 23.7 covers Beck's cognitive therapy: the cognitive model (Figure 23-2), the cognitive theory of depression, the structure of treatment, eliciting and testing automatic thoughts, identifying maladaptive assumptions, cognitive distortions (Figure 23-3 and Table 23-11), behavioral techniques (Figure 23-4) and indications. A dashed box adds the 2022 NICE depression guideline.
objectives: Explain the cognitive model and Beck's cognitive triad of depression.
Describe the structure, length and didactic parts of cognitive therapy.
Elicit and test automatic thoughts and identify maladaptive assumptions.
Name the common cognitive errors and how each is addressed (Table 23-11).
Describe the behavioral techniques used in cognitive therapy and its indications.
